title: Change password
hint: For accounts that sign in with email and password. Use 8–128 characters. Changing your password signs out other sessions; this session stays signed in.
required: Enter your current password and your new password twice.
length: Use a new password between 8 and 128 characters.
mismatch: The new passwords do not match.
different: Choose a password different from your current password.
incorrect: Your current password is incorrect. Enter your passwords again.
expired: Your session has expired. Sign in again before changing your password.
rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait before trying again.
failed: Unable to confirm the password change. Check whether the new password works before trying again.
success: Password changed. Other sessions have been signed out.
